summary: Iteration 8 frontend-only testing (background nav settings + per-threshold voice break warnings). Mobile viewport 390x844. All testIDs from the brief responded: auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit login OK with driver@test.com/test1234. On Tacógrafo tab, settings-btn opens settings-screen; break-warning-row-30/15/10/5 render; break-warning-switch-30/15/10/5 defaults verified as 30=on, 15=off, 10=on, 5=off (read via native checkbox input.checked). background-location-status shows exactly 'Solo en la app móvil' on web preview, and background-location-btn is present but disabled (unsupported branch). Toggling 15 on and 30 off, pressing settings-back-btn and reopening settings keeps the toggled values (verified visually; AsyncStorage/localStorage writes via /src/settings.ts setBreakWarnings persist across the back/reopen cycle inside the same browser session). Break warning in navigator: prepped via API by deleting all prior events for driver@test.com (3 found, 3 deleted) then POST /tacho/events/manual {DRIVING, now-4h05m -> now-1min} and POST /tacho/events {DRIVING live}; tacho/status returned remaining_continuous_driving_s=1559 (~25.9 min). In the Ruta tab typed 'Barcelona' -> dest-search-btn -> search-result-0 -> use-current-hours-switch already ON -> calc-route-btn -> start-navigation-btn. On navigate-screen (demo mode default on web) within ~1 second nav-break-notice appeared with text 'Pausa obligatoria en 23 minutos. Área más cercana: FREE TRUCK PARKING, a 16 kilómetros.' (matches 'Pausa obligatoria en' + minutes + 'Área más cercana'). nav-background-status visible with text 'Simulación'. nav-exit-btn returned to the map tab with no red screen (previous iteration's expo-keep-awake crash is gone). Regression: nav-banner, nav-voice-toggle, nav-eta all present during navigation; open-trips-btn opens trips-sheet on the clean map tab (confirmed in a separate run - it is hidden while a route is still displayed on the map which is expected). Cleanup: deleted the 2 tacho events created for this test; GET /api/tacho/events now returns [] and /api/tacho/status returns current_state='REST', continuous_driving_s=0, so driver@test.com is sane.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx (97 lines) - clean. BG permission branch is correctly disabled on web (backgroundSupported() returns false on Platform.OS==='web' or Expo Go storeClient).
settings.ts - storage.getItem is awaited; useBreakWarnings loads defaults then overlays persisted values via spread, so new keys added later would still have sane defaults.
background-nav.ts - TaskManager.defineTask is correctly guarded by Platform.OS!=='web' at module scope, which is required for TaskManager.

navigate.tsx break warning useEffect (lines 324-358) uses spokenRef keys 'brk-<stopKey>-<m>' and marks every threshold <= breakIn so later thresholds don't repeat. Nearest-area selection filters to same-direction (route_km > along) and prefers areas with drive_s_from_start <= breakIn+60 - matches spec.
navigate.tsx reads getBreakWarnings() once on mount into breakWarn.current. If the user flips a switch while already navigating the change won't apply until the next trip - minor UX note, not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested testIDs responded as expected
